summary: __thiscall setter with change notification. Guards on a2: when a2 differs from -1 and from the currently stored value this[11], it dispatches a value-change notification to the global GameDeviceObject through its vtable at +252, passing this object id (*this), field slot 11 and the new value a2, then stores a2 into this[11]. Returns the dispatch result.

operations.description: Skip the notification and store when a2 equals -1 (invalid/no-change sentinel) or when a2 equals the previously stored value this[11].
Read this object id from *this and call the __stdcall handler at vtable offset +252 on the GameDeviceObject global dword_8B89A0 with arguments (*this, 11, a2).
Store the accepted value into this[11] (byte offset 0x2C), making it the new baseline for the change guard.
Return the result of the vtable+252 dispatch; when the guard fails the uninitialized result is returned instead.

unresolved: Semantics of field slot 11 and of the object selector *this depend on the GameDeviceObject contract, which is not visible here.
Return value of the vtable+252 handler is propagated but its meaning is unknown.
